applications.name: Wombo Combo
applications.description: Whenever the Defender activates a Special Attack, the Attacker's Combo Meter is consumed and reset to zero. For each Hit in the Combo Meter consumed, the Defender gains a Passive Prowess, increasing Special Attack by [16982bff]20%[-] for 8 seconds. Max 30.
